people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
translations.bsb: Now Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor. So when Solomon noticed that the young man was industrious, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph.
translations.kjv: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
translations.asv: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he gave him charge over all the labor of the house of Joseph.
